name: Trading, Gifts and Ownership
summary: Characters may trade ordinary civilian goods using local currency when the GM considers it reasonable. Military and restricted equipment remains governed by Availability and provenance even if someone has enough money to pay for it. A character may give equipment to an ally, but doing so does not grant proficiency, species compatibility, ammunition supply, legal authority or maintenance knowledge. Institutions may also treat issued wargear as property that must be returned.
